prompt:
Create ONE animation-frame asset for a precise architectural projection-mapping film. Reference image 1 is the already approved DIRECT TOP-DOWN building projection; use it only to understand the strictly vertical camera and soft static illumination. DO NOT redraw or include the building.

Output a square RGBA image on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, containing exactly FOUR fully clothed ordinary high-school students, viewed exactly from directly overhead (camera at 90 degrees, orthographic, only tops of heads/shoulders and foreshortened arms, legs and shoes visible; absolutely no front-view or isometric people).
This image is a single synchronized walking-animation frame with four independently reusable characters, laid out in four equal quadrants with generous transparent gaps, no grid or labels. Each person is centered at their quadrant center: upper-left (25%,25%), upper-right (75%,25%), lower-left (25%,75%), lower-right (75%,75%). Everyone walks toward the TOP of the image. Each complete person silhouette stays inside the central 75% of their own quadrant, at identical real-world scale.
Character A upper-left: short dark curly hair, navy blue sweatshirt, light khaki pants, white sneakers.
Character B upper-right: brown ponytail, muted coral sweatshirt, blue jeans, white sneakers.
Character C lower-left: short dark hair, forest green hoodie, charcoal pants, dark sneakers.
Character D lower-right: short auburn hair, mustard yellow sweatshirt, navy pants, light sneakers.
Photorealistic miniature people with clean readable colored clothing, natural age-appropriate proportions and realistic overhead foreshortening. No accessories, backpacks, logos or writing.
Animation frame 01 of a 24-frame seamless single-stride walking cycle, phase 0 degrees: left foot forward, right foot back, right arm forward and left arm back. Modest relaxed gait, no exaggerated limb spread.
Lighting is perfectly fixed, diffuse neutral overhead illumination, same brightness across all four people, no sunlight, no directional or cast shadows, no floor, no scenery, no walls, no vignette. Transparency must be real alpha, not a checkerboard pattern. Render just these four isolated students.
BACKGROUND CORRECTION: Edit this single walking-animation frame. Preserve the FOUR overhead students, exact size, pixel positions, quadrants, clothing, hair, camera and pose. Replace the entire checkerboard background with a completely uniform solid vivid magenta (#FF00FF / RGB 255,0,255) background for chroma-key compositing. No checkerboard, transparency preview, gradient, floor, shadows or labels. Keep clean silhouette edges. This is frame 01, phase 0 degrees, of a 24-frame loop; left foot forward / right foot back. Strict vertical orthographic top down. Output one square image.
